tuition.title: MGA - Undergraduate tuition and fees (Fall 2026, Spring 2027, Summer 2027)

test_policy.notes: MGA's test FAQ states 'MGA does not require SAT or ACT Tests'. Regular admission needs a 2.0 high school GPA, the 17-unit required curriculum, and at least one Reading/Writing criterion (GPA 2.7+, or SAT EBRW 480+, or ACT English/Reading 17+, among others) and one Math criterion (GPA 3.1+, or SAT Math 440+, or ACT Math 17+, among others). Applicants not meeting those can be considered for Access admission with a 2.0 GPA and may be placed in Learning Support. The international pages do not mention ACT/SAT.

requirements.notes: Apply through MGA's online application ($30, non-refundable, per the 4-steps page); the Common App is not mentioned. International applicants need a course-by-course credential evaluation (including GPA) sent directly to Admissions, proof of English if applicable, immunization form, affidavit of financial support, and bank proof of at least $30,014 (undergraduate; statement or signed bank letter in English, dated within six months).

deadlines.label: International application deadline (fall 2027)
deadlines.notes: International page: fall application June 1 and documents July 1; spring November 1 / December 1; summer April 1 / May 1. The dates are printed without a year, so fall 2027 is assumed. The admissions FAQ says the posted date is a priority deadline and applications are accepted after it.

deadlines.label: International documents deadline (fall 2027)
deadlines.notes: Fall document deadline from the same table; the year 2027 is assumed.

deadlines.label: International student scholarship deadline (fall)
deadlines.notes: Needs a completed admission application, 3.0 high school GPA, one-page statement of purpose and the Presidential Waiver Application. The page text refers to fall 2025; the date is printed without a year, so 2027 is assumed. The out-of-state waiver page also gives May 1 for fall.

english_policy.waiver_notes: Required when the primary language is not English and the applicant has not attended a U.S. institution of higher education. Besides tests, SAT EBRW 480+ or ACT English 17+ is accepted as proof, as are UK GCSE/A-Level English 'C' or better and Cambridge IGCSE/O Level 'D' or better. Duolingo, conditional admission and an ESL pathway are not mentioned on the page.

english.notes: Includes Home Edition and Paper Edition. No 1-6 band value given.
IELTS Indicator accepted only through December 2023.
Cambridge English Scale score (B2 First, C1 Advanced or C2 Proficiency). Michigan English Test 55 and EIKEN Pre-1 are also accepted.

cost.notes: From the Fall 2026/Spring 2027 table at 15 credit hours, doubled: in-state tuition $2,640 per semester; out-of-state total $10,631 and out-of-country total $10,916 per semester, each including $431 of mandatory fees (so tuition $10,200 and $10,485). Fees can be lower at Dublin, Eastman or Warner Robins (recreation fee $90). Housing and meal costs were not collected, so they are not shown

aid.notes: The international scholarship (new fall international students, 3.0 high school GPA, statement of purpose, deadline May 1) can waive up to half of the out-of-state tuition differential and is renewable for up to 4 years with a 2.5 cumulative GPA. Awards are competitive; the out-of-state waiver page says waivers are limited and first come, first served, with no dollar amounts printed.

toefl.note: No TOEFL institution code is printed on the pages read.
